This '''[[OOM command battle droid/Legends|OOM command battle droid]]''' was one of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|separatists]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] [[Commander/Legends|commanders]], which were deployed for [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|the invasion]] of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. He was a subordinate of [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Mar Tuuk/Legends|Mar Tuuk]], and served in [[Procurer|his flagship]]. When [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] tricked Tuuk with a false surrender, and sent his own [[Defender/Legends|starship]] against the [[Procurer|battleship]], Tuuk fled with an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]], leaving the droid to [[Death/Legends|perish]] alongside the doomed ship.

==Biography==
===Blockade of Ryloth===
{{Quote|Sir, the squadron of fighters are attacking. They have a clear path right to us.''"<br />"''Now is the time to bring in our reinforcements.|The OOM command battle droid and Mar Tuuk|<ref name="SOR" />}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="TCWn" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] was [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|invaded]] by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. [[Emir/Legends|Emir]] [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]], the [[Foreman/Legends|Foreman]] of the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] and the leading [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the invasion, tasked [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Mar Tuuk/Legends|Mar Tuuk]] with commanding the [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] over Ryloth. This [[OOM command battle droid/Legends|OOM command battle droid]] was deployed as his [[Adjutant/Legends|adjutant]], and was stationed on the [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class Droid Control Ship]] ''[[Procurer]]'', which served as Tuuk's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]]. The blockade also contained two [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigates]].<ref name="SOR" />

[[File:MarTuuksOOM2.png|thumb|left|300px|The commander droid overviews the space battle]]
Shortly before the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] launched an offensive to break through the Separatist [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and liberate Ryloth, Tambor contacted Tuuk via [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]], to ensure that Tuuk's forces could withstand the attack. The commander [[Droid/Legends|droid]] stanted next to the Neimoidian captain when Tuuk assured Tambor that the blockade was impenetrable. Moments later, three Republic [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Venator-class Star Destroyer]] entered the [[Ryloth system/Legends|system]]. When a [[Blue Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|squadron]] of Republic [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighters]], led by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], started the assault, Tuuk ordered the command droid to launch all [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droids]] against them. The command droid obeyed, and soon the Vulture droids engaged the Republic [[Starfighter/Legends|fighters]]. During the fight, the commander droid stood behind Tuuk, discussing with a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]. They watched as Tuuk examined one the Republic [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]], the [[Defender/Legends|''Defender'']], and realized that the ship was [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]]. The droid then moved to monitor the battle, and informed Tuuk that the Republic [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] was approaching the battleship. The Neimoidian launched his trap, ordering four more ''Munificent''-class star frigates to join the blockade, and the commander soon told that the enemy fighters were surrounded by the frigates' Vulture Droids. Outnumbered and suffering heavy losses, the Republic forces chose to retreat. Noticing this, the command droid asked Tuuk should they pursue the fleeing enemy, but the captain denied it, not wanting to break the formation.<ref name="SOR" />

===Destruction===
{{Quote|Sir, an enemy ship is emerging from hyperspace.''"<br />"''I knew he'd return.''"<br />"''There is an incoming transmission, sir.''"<br />"''Put it through.|The OOM command battle droid and Mar Tuuk|<ref name="SOR" />}}
After the attack, Tuuk wanted to learn more about his enemy, and ordered the commander droid to bring him the archive data of Skywalker, which the droid quickly delivered. After he had read about the well-known Jedi General, Tuuk was more than certain that Skywalker wouldn't give up. He commanded the command droid to prepare the cannons and troops to battle. Droid commander wondered the decision, and asked were they under attack, which captain replied that Skywalker would definitely return. The droid then proceeded to fulfill the order.<ref name="SOR" />

[[File:MarTuukOOM.png|thumb|right|300px|The commander droid reports Mar Tuuk about the ''Defender'']]
Shortly after, the command battle droid informed captain Tuuk that the Republic ship, the ''Defender'', had just appeared from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], and was sending a transmission. It was sent by Skywalker, who, via monitor, offered himself and his cruiser, alongside its crew, to surrender, in exchange of the safe passage of food and medical supplies to the suffering [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]] of Ryloth. The commander droid watched the negotiation, which Tuuk showed substantial interest to the bargain, as the capturing of General Skywalker would make the Separatist Captain a celebrated hero. However, Skywalker's ship was scanned, and one of the B1 battle droids revealed the results: the ship was heavily damaged, with all power diverted to the forward shields, but there was only one life-form aboard. Skywalker then sent the ''Defender'' against Tuuk's flagship and [[Escape pod/Legends|evacuated]], leaving the two ships to collide. Although Tuuk tried to save the situation by ordering all [[Cannon/Legends|cannons]] to fire on the ''Defender'', chaos and panic started to spread as some of the droids, including the OOM command battle droid, initiated to senselessly skitter along the command bridge.<ref name="SOR" />

The cannons were ultimately unable to stop the ''Defender'', and the commander asked Tuuk's advices. Knowing that the ''Defender'' was now unstoppable, the Neimoidian relinquished command to the droid, and fled his doomed flagship with an escape pod. The commander droid was destroyed alongside the battleship when the ''Defender'' rammed with it, paving the way to the Republic invasion forces.<ref name="SOR" />

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|We can't stop it. What should we do?''"<br />"''You stay here. I'll be back.''"<br />"''Oh, that's bright.|The OOM command battle droid and Mar Tuuk, as the ''Defender'' comes closer|<ref name="SOR" />}}
Like all [[OOM command battle droid/Legends|OOM command battle droids]], this commander droid was capable for independent thought. He served as captain Mar Tuuk's personal assistant, dutifully fulfilling the orders he received. While Tuuk was in command, the droid mostly stayed in background, letting the captain make the command decisions.<ref name="SOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Like all of the [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s and [[OOM command battle droid/Legends|OOM command battle droids]] on the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|Star Wars animated TV series]], this commander droid was voiced by [[Matthew Wood]]. Alongside many of the commander droids in series, his real name is currently unknown, as he was only referred as Commander in [[Storm Over Ryloth]].
